blurb: Apache Wells Country Club offers an 18-hole, par-71 golf course with a 6,100 yard layout suitable for all skill levels. The club features a restaurant called White Feather Bar & Grill and hosts social events, tournaments, and weddings. Facilities include electric golf carts with overstuffed seats, multiple bathrooms, and water stations.
